titulo.alumno: Asking for information and solving a travel problem

intro: In this lesson you will practice asking for information and solving a travel problem.

texto: Combine description, past and a request for information; check what step follows before closing the matter.

frases.estudio: Θα ήθελα να μάθω αν το εισιτήριο αλλάζει και πόσο κοστίζει η νέα κράτηση.
frases.alumno: I'd like to know whether the ticket can be changed and how much the new booking costs.

frases.estudio: Στην πινακίδα βλέπω την ώρα αναχώρησης· το μήνυμα λέει ότι η αποβάθρα άλλαξε.
frases.alumno: On the sign I can see the departure time; the message says the platform has changed.

frases.estudio: Συγγνώμη, μπορείτε να εξηγήσετε ξανά τη διαδικασία; Θα ακολουθήσω τις οδηγίες.
frases.alumno: Excuse me, could you explain the process again? I'll follow the instructions.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the exchange and select the problem and the agreed step.
